title: Recording Output Delegate Deadlock Fix
requirements: Replace the continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>? and captureError: Error? mutable fields in RecordingOutputDelegate with state behind a Mutex<DelegateState> (Swift 6.0 synchronization); remove the @unchecked Sendable annotation

Robust to delivery order via pre-resume: when didFinishRecordingTo fires, store the result in Mutex state immediately; if it fires before waitForCompletion installs the continuation, the next waitForCompletion resumes immediately from stored state without awaiting a continuation nobody will resume
Remove the @MainActor annotation on waitForCompletion to eliminate the cross-actor hop; the delegate runs on the AudioRecorder actor, since AVFoundation callbacks do not target the main thread
acceptance_criteria: 50 sequential start()→stop() cycles complete in <2 seconds each with no hang
swift test --sanitize=thread is clean — no Thread Sanitizer warnings on RecordingOutputDelegate
The callback can fire before or after waitForCompletion enters without hanging
out_of_scope: Changing the recording format or .m4a container
